maintenance_windows_shape.name: maintenance_windows_shape
maintenance_windows_shape.value:
(
        "maintenance_windows"."recurrence" = 'once'
        and "maintenance_windows"."starts_at" is not null
        and "maintenance_windows"."start_minute_of_day" is null
      ) or (
        "maintenance_windows"."recurrence" <> 'once'
        and "maintenance_windows"."start_minute_of_day" between 0 and 1439
      )

maintenance_windows_monthday.name: maintenance_windows_monthday
maintenance_windows_monthday.value:
"maintenance_windows"."by_monthday" is null or "maintenance_windows"."by_monthday" = -1
        or "maintenance_windows"."by_monthday" between 1 and 31

probe_rounds_prunable_idx.name: probe_rounds_prunable_idx
probe_rounds_prunable_idx.where: "probe_rounds"."decided_at" is not null and "probe_rounds"."raw_pruned_at" is null

alert_routing_bindings_scope.name: alert_routing_bindings_scope
alert_routing_bindings_scope.value:
("alert_routing_bindings"."scope" = 'organization' and "alert_routing_bindings"."monitor_id" is null)
        or ("alert_routing_bindings"."scope" = 'monitor' and "alert_routing_bindings"."monitor_id" is not null)

alert_routing_targets_kind.name: alert_routing_targets_kind
alert_routing_targets_kind.value:
("alert_routing_targets"."kind" = 'channel' and "alert_routing_targets"."escalation_policy_id" is null)
        or ("alert_routing_targets"."kind" = 'escalation_policy' and "alert_routing_targets"."channel_id" is null)

runbook_bindings_scope.name: runbook_bindings_scope
runbook_bindings_scope.value:
("runbook_bindings"."scope" = 'organization' and "runbook_bindings"."monitor_id" is null)
        or ("runbook_bindings"."scope" = 'monitor' and "runbook_bindings"."monitor_id" is not null)

slo_alert_rules_thresholds.name: slo_alert_rules_thresholds
slo_alert_rules_thresholds.value:
"slo_alert_rules"."threshold_milli" > 0
        and "slo_alert_rules"."min_coverage_permille" between 0 and 1000
        and "slo_alert_rules"."recovery_factor_permille" between 1 and 1000
        and "slo_alert_rules"."recovery_seconds" between 0 and 86400

slo_burn_alerts_open_idx.name: slo_burn_alerts_open_idx
slo_burn_alerts_open_idx.where: "slo_burn_alerts"."resolved_at" is null and "slo_burn_alerts"."rule_id" is not null

slos_sli_shape.name: slos_sli_shape
